recognize_zh: A 圖周邊血可見數個中小型不典型淋巴樣細胞，核形不規則、有凹陷或分葉（部分呈花瓣狀），另可見吞噬細胞碎屑的大細胞；B 圖 ALK IHC 在多個中小型細胞呈核與胞質陽性，支持 ALK 陽性間變性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）小細胞型的白血化期。
features: Small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented to lobulated ('flower-like') nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin and a thin rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm; large hallmark cells are not evident
Occasional large cell with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing debris (histiocyte-like)
ALK immunostain (panel B) shows nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity in a subset of small-to-medium cells
Many admixed ALK-negative background cells, indicating the neoplastic cells are a minority population
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panel A) shows scattered small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented, and lobulated nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm, together with an occasional large cell with vacuolated cytoplasm. Large pleomorphic hallmark cells are not prominent at this magnification. Immunohistochemistry for ALK (panel B) on a cytologic preparation shows nuclear and cytoplasmic staining in a subset of small and medium-sized cells, a pattern typical of the NPM1::ALK fusion. Findings are consistent with the small-cell variant of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma in leukemic phase.

ddx.vs: ATLL shows polylobated 'flower cells' too, but is HTLV-1 associated and ALK negative, with typically CD25-positive, CD30-variable cells.
T-PLL cells have a single prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, and are TCL1-positive and ALK/CD30 negative.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei with a CD4+/CD7−/CD26− phenotype and lack ALK expression.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and a polyclonal phenotype without ALK or strong CD30 staining.
